structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly proportional to epochs times per-epoch cost, which grows with conv FLOPs (stage widths weighted by spatial resolution). A low-resolution early phase cuts cost by about 36% of the fraction used. Muon adds a fixed overhead. Accuracy rises with log epochs and width, and falls with low-res phases and cutout. It is also hurt by heavy label smoothing and random flip, and helped by smaller translation and by Muon.
